description: Election Commission - R. G. K. Jayasingha Manike was selected as the member of the Haldummulla P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Haldummulla Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a seat that became vacant due to death, which falls under electoral processes and candidate registrations. This content directly relates to election administration procedures rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
